verdict.rationale: Cline shows every edit as a reviewable diff in VS Code and JetBrains, and Kanban adds diff review with inline comments. It can also run tests, pipe a `git diff` in for review, and run headlessly in GitHub Actions or GitLab pipelines. However, no evidence shows a documented pre-merge gate or PR check that blocks merges, and the check-running claims are vendor-only. Missing for 10: documented pre-merge/PR check gating tied to merge workflows, details on how lint/test check results are surfaced as pass/fail before merge, and independent hands-on corroboration of the review-and-check flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging
